### Frank and Penelope (2019) — Survival, Redemption & The Search for Freedom 🎬

Frank and Penelope is a crime thriller following two troubled strangers whose lives collide during a desperate attempt to escape their pasts. Frank, a man searching for a fresh start, crosses paths with Penelope, a woman trying to break free from a dangerous situation. Their meeting sets off a chain of events that forces them into a world filled with violence, unpredictable characters, and difficult choices.

As their journey unfolds, the two form an unexpected connection while facing threats that test their courage and trust in one another. With danger closing in, they must decide whether to keep running from their problems or confront the people and circumstances that have trapped them.

The film explores freedom, survival, trust, desperation, and the consequences of past decisions. It shows how people pushed to their limits can discover unexpected strength while searching for a way out of a life they no longer want.

What makes Frank and Penelope compelling is its dark atmosphere, intense confrontations, and unpredictable journey. Beneath the violence lies a story about two people searching for control over their own lives in a world that offers few easy choices.

💬 “Sometimes, escaping your past is only the beginning of the fight to reclaim your future.”
